level_3.title: Golden Bullet
level_3.description: All your weapons carry 10% more bullets (minimum 1 extra bullet!)

level_3.title: Head-Seeking Bullets
level_3.description: Increases your chance of a critical hit by 50%.

level_3.title: Barbarian's Serum
level_3.description: You deal 25% more damage with your Melee weapon.

level_3.title: Lucky Shot
level_3.description: All shots have a 1% chance of dealing critical damage.

level_3.title: Rigged Guns
level_3.description: Your accuracy is slightly reduced. You’ll have to aim more carefully!

level_3.title: Toy Sword
level_3.description: Your Melee weapon deals 25% less damage.

level_3.title: Rusty Weapons
level_3.description: Your weapons have a chance of jamming, forcing you to reload.

level_3.title: Ammo Rationing
level_3.description: Your guns have 10% less bullet capacity.

level_3.title: Black Cat
level_3.description: Your weapons will land no critical hits.

level_2.title: Zombies With Helmets!
level_2.description: Landing critical hits is twice as hard.

level_2.title: Bobblehead Zombies
level_2.description: Zombies will have huge heads! Landing criticals is way easier!

level_2.title: Enraged Horde
level_2.description: Get ready! Zombies will get increasingly faster and tougher!

level_2.title: Thick Skin
level_2.description: Uh-oh, Zombies have 20% more hit points!

level_2.title: Failed Experiments
level_2.description: Yay! Zombies have 10% less hit points!

level_1.title: Electric Shield
level_1.description: Kills the first Zombie who gets too close.

level_1.title: Free Revive
level_1.description: You can revive for free on your first death.

level_1.title: Herd of Cows
level_1.description: Dr. Bastard releases annoying cows in the arena.

level_1.title: Car Symphony
level_1.description: Car alarms will go off around you. Shoot the cars to blow them up!

level_1.title: Jukebox
level_1.description: An old jukebox keeps playing anticlimatic music. Shoot it to turn it off.

level_1.title: Thunder storm
level_1.description: A strong storm will hinder your hearing.

level_1.title: Generator Malfunction
level_1.description: A loud generator is running in the arena. Shoot it stop it for a while.

level_1.title: SUPER COMBO
level_1.description: You start the game with double Combo. Score more, and get more coins!

level_1.title: More Power Ups!
level_1.description: Power Ups are delivered more often.

level_1.title: Powered Power Ups
level_1.description: All Power Ups are fully levelled up for this game.
